info.title: HomeLab agent-service private inventory and operations
info.description: R01 owner-scoped read model, R02 durable operations, R07 versioned Docker host metadata/observations, R12 immutable Harness history replication/offline reads, R13 owner-scoped logical dialog deletion, and R14 retained replica search/deep links. Docker sockets, SSH keys, passphrases, native workdirs/results and registry secret bytes remain outside this service.
